verdict.rationale: Column documents its own reporting feature, which offers bank-account transaction and summary reports in CSV, JSON and Parquet. Its API also lets you query all transfers and retrieve raw wire messages, so key financial data can be pulled out in open formats. Coverage is limited to two report types, though, and nothing documents a complete export of all account data or an exit process. Missing for 10: a documented full-data export covering all object types (accounts, entities, cards, events), offboarding or account-closure guidance, and independent or hands-on confirmation of export completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Column provides the following reports: `bank_account_transaction` and `bank_account_summary`. All reports are available in CSV, JSON, and Parquet formats.
Query transfers across all payment types from a single unified endpoint.
You can access the raw message for domestic wires using our get wire transfer API endpoint
Column automatically produces monthly statements for all open bank accounts on your platform.
